name: Hana to Otome ni Shukufuku o -Royal Bouquet-
original_name: 花と乙女に祝福を ロイヤルブーケ
source:
This is the fandisc for Hana to Otome ni Shukufuku wo, featuring after stories for each of the heroines from the original game.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/01/01/january-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
《花与少女的祝福》的粉丝向光盘，收录原作各女主角的后日谈。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/01/01/january-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
